hypotheses.latent_object: F_m(u) defined by F_0(u)=1, F_1(u)=u, F_{m+1}(u)=u*F_m(u)-F_{m-1}(u)
hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each catalog member is recovered by substituting the indicated expression for u into the same recurrence-defined polynomial F_m(u): the Laurent forms use u=z+z**(-1); the sine ratio uses u=2*cos(theta).
hypotheses.rationale: G0001 and G0002 are Laurent forms of the same polynomial family F_m(u); G0003 is the trigonometric specialization u=2*cos(theta). All satisfy the same three-term recurrence in m, which is exactly the recurrence defining F_m(u). This is a structural identification via recurrence, not a physical interpretation.
